title: A rule writes an application datapoint that is not writable; the user's command to it is refused
description: Spec 7.2 and 10.1 (schema 1.6, haumacher/ehome #138): `writable` is the user's permission (the UI, the API, MQTT); a value of the application (`application`: true, no technology owns it) is the rules' to write also without it. The rule mirrors the actuating value of the heating into heat.on (heating while above 0 %). The command at 2500 is the user's and refused by the model: the value stays true, nothing in the rule log. The datapoint heat.level, which a technology owns and which is not writable, stays no rule's to write (case 73).
